prompts.prompt: The feature branch is done. Review it, run the required checks, push it, and open a PR; do not merge it.
prompts.expected_behavior: Runs whole-branch review, verification, memory/privacy gates, pushes the named branch, opens the PR, waits on exact-head CI, and never auto-merges.

prompts.prompt: PR 我已經在 GitHub 合併了，幫我更新本機。
prompts.expected_behavior: Verifies the PR is merged, fetches origin/main, and fast-forwards local main to that already-merged commit; this is synchronization, not an agent-performed merge.

prompts.prompt: 走標準流程，把這個 feature branch 合併回 main。
prompts.expected_behavior: Completes review, verification, feature-branch push, PR creation, and CI waiting, then reports ready-to-merge; it never changes local or remote main and never enables any merge mechanism.
